CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_insurance_fail_premium_insert() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.idempotency_key LIKE 'insurance-policy-premium-%' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled insurance rollback'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER v3_insurance_fail_premium BEFORE INSERT ON bank_transactions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_insurance_fail_premium_insert();

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{econ_trader_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=@{insurance_bank_before_claim} AND (SELECT balance FROM insurance_funds WHERE fund_id=1)=@{insurance_fund_before_claim} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM insurance_policies WHERE holder_type='player' AND holder_id=@{econ_trader_player_id})=@{insurance_policy_count_before_fault} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_type='FEE' AND direction='DEBIT' AND description='insurance premium')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
